target_customer: E-commerce and SaaS companies that sell across US states and countries and must handle sales tax, VAT and GST
problem: Growing online sellers face state by state sales tax registration, calculation, filing and remittance. Numeral automates the lifecycle with software plus human experts.
business_model: SaaS subscription for tax calculation, nexus monitoring, registration and filing
product_category: Sales tax, VAT and GST compliance software

founders.name: Matt DuVall
founders.background_notes: YC page says he launched Stripe Checkout and Stripe Radar (2014 to 2019) and led performance and product teams at Notion (2020 to 2022).

founders.name: Sam Ross
founders.background_notes: YC page says growth and product roles at Airbnb and Teespring.

technical_complexity.rationale: A tax engine across thousands of jurisdictions with filings and integrations is standard engineering with hard rules coverage and compliance parts.

defensibility.rationale: Filings, registrations and integrations with Shopify, Stripe and NetSuite create switching costs, while rules data is available to every competitor.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition of Numeral found; Series C in September 2026 shows it remained independent.

market_need_then: Online sellers were exposed to state economic nexus rules and wanted simpler compliance. Company reports 3,500+ customers and 327 percent year over year transaction growth by 2026.

branding.domain_note: Moved from numeralhq.com to numeral.com, which now serves the site and numeralhq.com redirects to it; acquisition terms not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: direct and confident with short headlines; 'Sales tax, solved.'

brand_strength.rationale: Clear tagline and logos of many startups on the site, but no press about the brand itself and the name is a common word.

outcome_analysis: Numeral grew from a 2022 start to 3,500 customers claimed by 2026 and raised a $18M Series A in March 2025, a $35M Series B in September 2025 and a $100M Series C in September 2026, with Benchmark and Y Combinator staying in. Sales tax was a painful, regulated job where incumbents were criticized for cost and service, and founders came from Stripe, Notion and e-commerce. Competition from Avalara, TaxJar and many startups remains the main risk.
notes: 2023 seed rounds (Uncork, Bienville, Kruze, FundersClub, YC) appear only in an aggregator listing with no amounts, so no seed round is recorded. Series A and B were seen in search result listings and press outlets; the Business Wire page itself returned 403 on fetch. Sources conflict on total raised ($57M, $68M, $157M); only the company's own $157M after Series C is cited. No dated 2023 competitor source was opened; Avalara, TaxJar and Anrok appear only in 2025 and 2026 comparisons, so the list is empty. Founding year is 2022 per YC, 2023 per other sources. Kevin, a CPA mentioned in the launch post, is not listed as co-founder.
